meta.title: Mobile Approvals: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Mobile Approvals availability and approval behavior for an Approver on a below-Growth tenant versus a Growth tenant, including the required tenant-plan setup and mobile sessions
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Mobile Approvals availability and approval behavior for an Approver on a below-Growth tenant versus a Growth tenant, including the required tenant-plan setup and mobile sessions

args.need: sign in as the same Approver on a below-Growth tenant and a Growth tenant, use Mobile Approvals to attempt the same approval on mobile, and verify that it is absent or refused below Growth but available and successful on Growth

steps.note: The catalog cannot access Mobile Approvals, perform mobile approval, sign in as an Approver, or change and compare tenant plans.
Assert that the session remains free of an application error after the tester's comparison.
